title: Why Storms Spin - The Coriolis Effect Explained
description:
The Coriolis effect is not a real force. It is an apparent deflection caused by Earth rotating beneath moving air and water.

In the Northern Hemisphere, moving objects deflect to the right. In the Southern Hemisphere, to the left. This shapes trade winds, jet streams, and the rotation direction of every hurricane on the planet.
